2.264.8
MapViewport.MapMeridians
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapViewport.MapMeridians element specifies the horizontal grid for a Map element. The
MapViewport.MapMeridians element is optional and is of type MapMeridians.
Following is the parent element of the MapViewport.MapMeridians element.
Parent elements
MapViewport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapViewport.MapMeridians element.
 <xsd:element name="MapMeridians" type="MapGridLinesType" minOccurs="0" />
